errors.text_span: The x-axis is labeled "Number of Frames" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1000, with tick labels at intervals of 200.
errors.evidence: The x-axis range appears to go to approximately 1000-1050 (the last data point is around 1024), and the tick labels are at 0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000 which is correct, but the description says 'ranging from 0 to 1000' when the axis visually extends slightly beyond 1000.

errors.text_span: It starts at approximately 3 GB at 0 frames, rises steadily to 10 GB at 200 frames, continues to around 16 GB at 800 frames, and concludes at approximately 17 GB at 1000 frames.
errors.evidence: VideoLLaMB (red line) appears to start at around 20+ GB (near the cluster of lines at the start) and the values reported (3 GB, 10 GB, 16 GB, 17 GB) are clearly incorrect. All lines start around 20-25 GB range in the figure.

errors.text_span: beginning at just over 1 GB at 0 frames and rising to approximately 5 GB at 1000 frames
errors.evidence: VideoLLaMB-R (olive/dark yellow line) starts around 20 GB and ends at approximately 40 GB at 1000 frames, not 1 GB and 5 GB.

errors.text_span: starting at around 1 GB at 0 frames and ending at approximately 6 GB at 1000 frames
errors.evidence: PLLaVA (green line) starts around 20 GB and ends at approximately 75 GB at 1000 frames, not 1 GB and 6 GB.

errors.text_span: beginning at 2 GB at 0 frames and reaching approximately 18 GB at 1000 frames
errors.evidence: LLaVA-NeXT (blue/cyan line) starts around 20-25 GB and reaches approximately 145 GB at 1000 frames, not 2 GB and 18 GB.

errors.text_span: showing a value of nearly 0 GB at 0 frames, increasing rapidly to 250 GB at 200 frames, and ending at approximately 380 GB at 1000 frames
errors.evidence: VideoLLAVA starts around 25-40 GB, peaks dramatically (going off chart above 400 GB around 250 frames), but the description says 'nearly 0 GB at 0 frames' which is incorrect. Also the line does not appear to extend to 1000 frames — it goes off the chart around 250 frames.

errors.text_span: VideoLLaMB, is red with circular markers and a dashed line style
errors.evidence: VideoLLaMB appears to use a dashed line (which is correct), but the color looks salmon/pink-red which is close. However, the line style description as 'dashed' may be partially correct based on the legend appearance.

errors.text_span: VideoLLaMB-R, is orange with circular markers and a solid line style
errors.evidence: VideoLLaMB-R appears to be an olive/dark yellow color, not orange.

errors.text_span: VideoLAVA is depicted as a purple line
errors.evidence: The legend and line show 'VideoLLAVA' (not 'VideoLAVA'). The description misspells the model name.
The description does not mention that the VideoLLAVA line goes off the chart (above 400 GB) around 250 frames, which is a visually prominent feature of the plot.

errors.text_span: with tick labels at intervals of 50
errors.evidence: The y-axis tick labels appear to be at intervals of 50 (0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350, 400), which is correct.
